top_family_plans.best_practice: signatureを説明変数へ分解し、浅いdecision tree/affine hash/color-role ruleへ置換する。arc-gen labelの丸暗記は禁止。
top_family_plans.preferred_lowering: small Gather, initializer-pruned decision tree, constant Slice/Gather when crop-like
top_family_plans.reject_lowering: large ScatterND table, full arc-gen memorization, large MatMul hash
top_family_plans.acceptance: full train/test/all-arc-gen exact, official utility pass, candidate cost lower than current, leakage/overfitting note, and family holdout before submit

top_family_plans.best_practice: fixed crop, anchor crop, bbox cropを分けて探索し、ONNX前にshape ruleとindex sizeをcost gateへ通す。
top_family_plans.preferred_lowering: constant Slice/Gather, small Concat/Pad, static row/column indices
top_family_plans.reject_lowering: NonZero/Compress, full-grid GatherND bbox, full-grid Tile plus mask
top_family_plans.acceptance: full train/test/all-arc-gen exact, official utility pass, candidate cost lower than current, leakage/overfitting note, and family holdout before submit

top_family_plans.best_practice: changed-cell maskを先に説明し、少数座標だけをemitする。広いmaskはConv/Reduceで閉形式化する。
top_family_plans.preferred_lowering: small Conv kernels, tiny GatherND/ScatterND, Equal plus single Where
top_family_plans.reject_lowering: large coordinate initializer, repeated full-grid Where, unrolled fill without cost forecast
top_family_plans.acceptance: full train/test/all-arc-gen exact, official utility pass, candidate cost lower than current, leakage/overfitting note, and family holdout before submit

top_family_plans.best_practice: seed color, direction, period, stop conditionをroleで推定し、絶対色より構造不変量を優先する。
top_family_plans.preferred_lowering: constant affine masks, row/column masks, small Conv line detectors
top_family_plans.reject_lowering: per-cell ScatterND table, long Where chains over all periods
top_family_plans.acceptance: full train/test/all-arc-gen exact, official utility pass, candidate cost lower than current, leakage/overfitting note, and family holdout before submit

top_family_plans.best_practice: complete/incomplete row-column、交点、stop blockerを列挙し、線分単位で正しさを証明する。
top_family_plans.preferred_lowering: ReduceSum row/column masks, small Conv kernels, constant masks plus Where
top_family_plans.reject_lowering: per-cell ScatterND table, full-grid Tile, long Where chain
top_family_plans.acceptance: full train/test/all-arc-gen exact, official utility pass, candidate cost lower than current, leakage/overfitting note, and family holdout before submit

top_family_plans.best_practice: flood fillを直接unrollせず、境界線・部屋・内外判定をrow/column prefixや小kernelで閉形式化する。
top_family_plans.preferred_lowering: static row/column ReduceSum masks, small Conv kernels, bounded single-pass room masks
top_family_plans.reject_lowering: radius-scale dilation, many-step flood-fill unroll, dynamic full-grid color map
top_family_plans.acceptance: full train/test/all-arc-gen exact, official utility pass, candidate cost lower than current, leakage/overfitting note, and family holdout before submit

top_family_plans.best_practice: flip/rotate/transpose/recolorを最小ONNXと既存artifact surgeryの両方で比較する。
top_family_plans.preferred_lowering: Transpose, Gather, initializer prune, small 1x1 Conv
top_family_plans.reject_lowering: rewriting an already compact artifact with a larger full-grid graph
